# AuthHub

> Client access platform for marketing agencies. Agencies send one link; clients authorize Meta, Google Ads, GA4, LinkedIn, and related platforms; tokens stay in Infisical with an audit log.

AuthHub is for digital marketing agencies that onboard clients across ad and analytics platforms and need access plus intake in one flow. It is not an influencer-whitelisting product.

## Product

- Audience: marketing agency owners, ops leads, and onboarding teams
- Job: collect client platform access in minutes instead of days of manual OAuth
- Pricing: https://authhub.co/pricing (flat tiers by active clients; 14-day trial)
- Docs: https://docs.authhub.co
- Security: https://authhub.co/security
